title: Dynamic-Threshold Algorithms for the Continuous Quadratic Knapsack Problem: Reset Mechanisms and Complexity
summary: Condat's algorithm is an efficient dynamic-threshold method for projection onto the simplex, but its extension to weighted equality constraints and the algorithmic roles of resetting and removal have received limited analysis. We develop a dynamic-threshold algorithm (DTA) for a continuous quadratic knapsack problem with a weighted equality constraint. DTA maintains a threshold invariant through three operations--addition, reset, and removal--and we establish its finite termination and correctness.
